atoms.text: The storm outside had not lessened, and the mansion shook with each gust of wind. Soon, a knock came at the door.
A man stepped into the room. His eyes were sharp, and his movements deliberate. “I’m Detective Harlow,” he said, showing his badge. “I need to ask a few questions about what happened.”

atoms.text: Dark cloud surrounded the mansion, and rain began to fall.
Mr Whitmore was in his office, writing letters and drinking tea.
A cry echoed through the halls, and everyone rushed to the study.
Mr Whitmore was found dead in his chair, a half-finished cup of tea tipped at his side.
Detective Harlow questioned the suspects and examined the study.
